# Julien Simon - AI Operating Partner

> Julien Simon is an AI Operating Partner at Fortino Capital with 30+ years of technology leadership. Expert in Small Language Models, enterprise AI implementation, and bridging AI research with practical business applications. #1 AI Evangelist globally (AI Magazine 2021). 685+ speaking engagements across 37 countries, 546K+ YouTube subscribers, 474+ technical articles. Author of "Learn Amazon SageMaker" (Packt Publishing). Previously VP & Chief Evangelist at Arcee AI, Chief Evangelist at Hugging Face, and Global Evangelist for AI/ML at AWS.

Last updated: 2026-06-11

## Key Facts

- Current role: AI Operating Partner at Fortino Capital (PE & VC)
- 685+ speaking engagements across 37 countries and 95 cities
- 546K+ YouTube subscribers, 459+ videos
- 474+ technical blog posts across AWS, Hugging Face, Medium, Arcee AI, and Substack
- Author of "Learn Amazon SageMaker" (Packt Publishing, 2 editions)
- #1 AI Evangelist globally (AI Magazine 2021)
- Featured in "The 100 Shaping AI in Europe" (L'Opinion & Oliver Wyman, 2025)
- Arm Ambassador (2025)
- 30+ years technology leadership

## Primary Expertise

- Small Language Models (SLMs) — cost-effective, privacy-first enterprise AI
- Enterprise AI Implementation — practical deployment strategies for production
- Private Equity AI Strategy — portfolio company acceleration
- Cloud Computing — AWS (10 certifications), infrastructure optimization
- Open Source AI — Hugging Face ecosystem, open-weights models
- AI Hardware — inference optimization across CPU, GPU, and AI accelerators

## Blog Categories

- [Industry Perspectives](https://www.julien.org/blog/industry-perspectives/): 76 company-agnostic AI industry analysis articles (2021–present)

Covers EU AI regulation, infrastructure economics, CPU inference, Small Language Models, and AI geopolitics.
